name: stewbeet
description: Syntax highlighting, block decorations and Spyglass-backed language features for mcfunction strings inside StewBeet write_* calls in Python files.

StewBeet.languageFeatures.markdownDescription: Enable completion, hover, signature help and go-to-definition inside mcfunction strings. Requires the [Spyglass](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=SPGoding.datapack-language-server) extension; without it these features are silently unavailable.

StewBeet.enableBlockDecorations.description: Enable/disable block decorations on mcfunction strings.

StewBeet.backgroundColor.markdownDescription: Background color of the mcfunction block decoration. Accepts any CSS color (`rgba(...)`, `#rrggbbaa`, ...).

StewBeet.borderColor.markdownDescription: Border color of the mcfunction block decoration. Accepts any CSS color.

StewBeet.borderWidth.markdownDescription: Border width of the mcfunction block decoration (e.g. `"1px"`, `"2px"`).

StewBeet.buildOutput.markdownDescription: Path or glob to the generated datapack root, the directory holding `pack.mcmeta`. Leave empty to search the whole workspace for `.mcfunction.map` files; set it when that search costs too much.

StewBeet.sourceMapDiagnostics.markdownDescription: Relay diagnostics reported against generated `.mcfunction` files onto the Python line that wrote them. Needs a build in the workspace.

StewBeet.resolveInterpolations.markdownDescription: Fill each `{...}` interpolation with what the last build resolved it to, so `function {ns}:utils/foo` is understood as the path it really is. Turn it off to mask every interpolation with `_` instead. Needs a build in the workspace.

StewBeet.diagnosticRuleDenylist.markdownDescription: Rules whose diagnostics are not relayed onto Python. `undeclaredSymbol` fires on every scoreboard objective or tag a dependency declares, which Spyglass cannot see. Set to `[]` to relay everything.

StewBeet.codeLens.markdownDescription: Show a clickable lens above each block that produced a function in the last build, linking to the generated file.

StewBeet.headerLinks.markdownDescription: Turn the function names inside a generated file's `#` header comments into links, so `@within` leads to the function that calls this one.

StewBeet.boltInMcfunction.markdownDescription: Treat a `.mcfunction` file that holds bolt as the `bolt` language instead of `mcfunction`. A project can enable bolt syntax inside `.mcfunction` files, and Spyglass then reports most of the file as a syntax error because it cannot parse a `for` loop. Turn this off to leave the language id alone. Generated files are never switched.

commands.title: StewBeet: Exclude Bolt Files From Spyglass
